 Kendall Jenner’s dad, Caitlyn Jenner, shocks model with explicit and inappropriate comment
 Caitlyn Jenner's rare appearance on The Kardashians took an unexpected turn when an innocent lunch with Kendall Jenner and Scott Disick became hilariously awkward
 © Getty Images 
 Shirley Gomez Senior Writer OCTOBER 22, 2026 11:33 AM EDT OCT 22, 2026, 11:33 AM EDT 
 Caitlyn Jenner is back on The Kardashians , and her latest appearance delivered a family moment Kendall Jenner probably wishes she could forget. During the October 22, 2026, episode of the Hulu reality series, the 76-year-old former Olympian reunited with her daughter Kendall, 30, for what was supposed to be a meaningful day celebrating the arrival of Kendall's horses at her property.
 But between Caitlyn's questions about Kendall's dating life and an unexpectedly inappropriate lunch comment, the reunion quickly became an exercise in secondhand embarrassment.
 © Getty Images Kendall Jenner (L) and Caitlyn Jenner on February 24, 2019 in Beverly Hills, California. 
 And Scott Disick? He was thoroughly entertained.
 Caitlyn Jenner's NSFW Comment Leaves Kendall Jenner Horrified
 The awkward moment unfolded when Caitlyn joined Kendall and Scott Disick, 43, for lunch. Everything started innocently enough, with Caitlyn admiring an egg sandwich before taking a bite. Unfortunately, the sandwich's runny yolk spilled onto her hand, prompting a rather graphic description of what had just happened.

 Caitlyn used an explicit expression that was censored during the broadcast. Kendall was visibly stunned by her dad's unexpected choice of words. "Dad, oh my God," she exclaimed. Caitlyn tried to explain that she was simply describing the messy sandwich, but the damage was done. For Kendall, hearing her father make that kind of joke was apparently enough to ruin her appetite.
 © Getty Images Caitlyn used an explicit expression that was censored during the broadcast. 
 Meanwhile, Scott found the exchange hilarious, particularly because he remembered getting into trouble for making similarly inappropriate jokes in the past. The model eventually gave up on eating her sandwich altogether.
 Caitlyn Jenner Questions Kendall About Her Love Life
 The lunch incident wasn't the only uncomfortable moment during Caitlyn's rare appearance. Earlier in the episode, Caitlyn wasted little time asking Kendall about her romantic relationships.
 The model, who has generally kept her dating life more private than some of her famous siblings, appeared surprised by the personal questioning. Caitlyn wanted to know whether anything new was happening romantically, explaining that she often feels like the last person to hear about her daughter's relationships.
 © WireImage The model, who has generally kept her dating life more private than some of her famous siblings, appeared surprised by the personal questioning. 
 Kendall, however, wasn't interested in providing an update. When Caitlyn checked whether she was doing okay, Kendall responded: "I am so okay it's unbelievable."
 Despite growing up on reality television, Kendall has frequently chosen to keep certain parts of her private life away from the cameras.
 Kendall Jenner's Relationship With Caitlyn Jenner Remains Complicated but Meaningful
 Caitlyn and Kendall's relationship has attracted attention over the years, particularly as the family has navigated changes following Caitlyn's divorce from Kris. During a previous season of The Kardashians, Kendall discussed wanting Caitlyn to feel included in family celebrations.
 © FilmMagic Caitlyn Jenner on May 22, 2024 in Beverly Hills, California. 
 She also acknowledged concerns about her father's loneliness and the importance of maintaining family connections. Despite being embarrassed by Caitlyn's lunch remarks, Kendall ultimately appreciated the time they spent together.
 Where to Watch Caitlyn Jenner on The Kardashians Season 8
 Caitlyn Jenner's surprise appearance is featured in the October 22, 2026, episode of The Kardashians season eight. The season premiered on October 8, 2026, and new episodes are released on Thursdays on Hulu in the United States.
